newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says most plants idle on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says most plants idle on Wednesday.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will continue halting vehicle production on Wednesday at most of its domestic plants, a Toyota spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.
It will resume output on two more domestic production lines on Thursday and expects to resume near-normal levels of output at all domestic production lines on Friday, he said.
On Wednesday it will halt most lines except for plants repairing parts and components for overseas production and a line for Toyota cars at Daihatsu Motor Co Ltd.
The stoppage is due to a fire last Saturday at a key parts supplier.
Toyota has no plans to revise its finely coordinated "just in time" or kanban system for getting components delivered without holding excess inventories, he added.
